title: DRACULA AGB1
knowledge: DRACULA AGB1 / agbcc: systemic frameless-branchy-leaf wall. Many small Thumb leaf functions with a backward branch (e.g. sub_08000BF0, sub_08000CC8, sub_08000CA0, sub_08000D4C, sub_08000C0C, sub_080016C4) have a byte-exact body but the ROM ends with bare `bx lr`, while this project's agbcc always emits `push {lr}` ... `pop {rX}` / `bx rX`, shifting all branch offsets by +2. Verified across O1/O2/O3/Os, -fno-strength-reduce, -mno-thumb-interwork and multiple C loop forms (do-while, while, for, goto, early/single exit): score floors at 245/235/445 etc. and cannot improve. Agents should stop afte

DRACULA AGB1 / diff-reading caveat: a "when linking your code at the function's address: you call X where the original calls something else" message together with a `bl #0xNNN` row whose small positive offset equals the call site's byte offset from the function start is usually a FALSE POSITIVE, not a symbol problem. It appears when your code is 2 bytes shorter (or longer) than the target before that call: every later `bl` displacement differs by 2, the harness can't align the row, prints the raw call-site offset, and reports the callee as wrong. DRACULA AGB1 literal-pool/extent wall: when every real target instruction is byte-exact and the only residual rows at the very end are a `movs r0,r0` alignment nop plus 2 rows decoding the bytes of a literal-pool word, the ROM's pool entry sits just past the function's declared extent. A standalone compile must emit its own pool inside the extent, so those rows can never be removed by C spelling, casts, constant formatting or in-profile flags. Release with a compiler/extent handoff; do not spend the compile budget on it.

DRACULA AGB1 frameless Thumb loop-leaf ABI wall: when a no-call leaf loop has a byte-exact real body but agbcc adds `push {lr}` and `pop {r0}; bx r0` where the ROM uses bare `bx lr`, treat it as compiler frame-emission, not loop C. Exact flags, -O1, -O3, and even explicit -fomit-frame-pointer preserve this inserted frame and branch-displacement ripple, while -Os/non-interwork are worse. Do not spend budget on while/do/for or pointer declaration permutations; a compiler/backend change is required.

DRACULA AGB1 / frameless Thumb leaf frame wall: when a no-call leaf's entire real target body is already byte-exact and the only residual is candidate `push {lr}` / `pop {r0}` / `bx r0` versus the ROM's frameless `bx lr`, with branch and literal offsets rippling by two, this is agbcc `-mthumb-interwork` prologue/epilogue emission, not a C-source mismatch. Source permutations cannot remove it. Confirm the compiler profile once with search_flags, then release with a compiler_settings handoff; matching requires an ABI/compiler mode that emits frameless Thumb leaves.
